title: Stable version for Donut chart

complexity.rationale: Investigation confirms Donut is still not stable today — it remains gated behind the package's `/rc` (release candidate) subpath export in both s1 and s2, one maturity step short of the main index. The mechanical export-promotion work is precedented (other marks already live in the stable `components/index.ts`), but deciding whether the current Donut/DonutSummary/SegmentLabel API surface is frozen enough to commit to as stable (a breaking-change/versioning decision, not just a file move) is a genuine open design question that a reviewer, not just an implementer, needs to weigh in on.

summary: Contrary to the assumption that this 2024 request is stale, investigation shows Donut has NOT been promoted to stable: packages/docs/docs/api/visualizations/Donut.md:1-3 explicitly states '## RELEASE CANDIDATE — Donut is currently in `rc`... the component, behavior and API are all subject to change,' and Donut/DonutSummary/SegmentLabel/BigNumber are exported only from the package's `/rc` entry point (packages/react-spectrum-charts/src/rc/components/index.ts, packages/react-spectrum-charts-s2/src/rc/components/index.ts), not from the stable `.` export (packages/react-spectrum-charts/src/components/index.ts, packages/react-spectrum-charts-s2/src/components/index.ts). Donut has matured from alpha to `rc` since the issue was filed (per git history: 'chore: promote donut to RC'), but the originally requested promotion to a stable version has not happened.
requirements: Audit the current Donut/DonutSummary/SegmentLabel API surface (packages/vega-spec-builder/src/types/marks/donutSpec.types.ts and supplemental types) for anything still expected to change, to decide whether it's ready to freeze as stable.
Once approved, move Donut, DonutSummary, and SegmentLabel exports from the `/rc` entry point to the main stable entry point in both react-spectrum-charts and react-spectrum-charts-s2.
Update packages/docs/docs/api/visualizations/Donut.md to remove the 'RELEASE CANDIDATE' banner and the `/rc` import instructions, replacing them with the standard stable import path.

Update any internal imports currently pulling from `../rc` (e.g. packages/react-spectrum-charts/src/utils/utils.ts:50, packages/react-spectrum-charts/src/rscToSbAdapter/childrenAdapter.ts:54, related story files) to import from the stable path instead.
Confirm this is a deliberate semver-relevant decision (likely a major/minor version bump per this project's versioning policy for RC-to-stable promotions) rather than a silent change.

edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Decide whether the `/rc` re-export is kept as a deprecated alias for a transition period, or removed immediately — avoid a silent breaking change for current adopters.

Both packages/react-spectrum-charts and packages/react-spectrum-charts-s2 currently gate Donut behind `/rc` identically; promotion must happen in both or the maturity levels between s1/s2 will diverge.

edgeCases.case: BigNumber and SegmentLabel share the same rc/components directory
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Confirm whether this promotion is scoped to Donut/DonutSummary/SegmentLabel only, or whether BigNumber (still separately requested in gh-74/gh-702/gh-703) is intentionally left in `/rc`.

crossCutting.notes: variant is 'both' because both react-spectrum-charts and react-spectrum-charts-s2 currently gate Donut behind their respective `/rc` exports identically, so the promotion plan already covers both packages from the outset.

implementationPlan.change: Remove Donut/DonutSummary/SegmentLabel exports once promoted (leave BigNumber, unless it's promoted too).
Add Donut, DonutSummary, SegmentLabel exports, moving the component directories from src/rc/components/ to src/components/.
Mirror the same export removal for s2.
Mirror the same component relocation for s2.
Update the `import { BigNumber, Donut, DonutSummary, SegmentLabel } from '../rc'` to import Donut/DonutSummary/SegmentLabel from the new stable location.
Update the `import { Donut, DonutSummary, SegmentLabel } from '../rc'` to the new stable import path.
Remove the RELEASE CANDIDATE banner and `/rc` import example; update to the stable import statement.

openQuestions: Is the current Donut/DonutSummary/SegmentLabel API considered feature-complete and frozen enough for a stable commitment, or should open feature requests (e.g. gh-577's DonutSummary value override) land first so they don't require a breaking change post-promotion?
Should the `/rc` subpath keep re-exporting Donut as a deprecated alias for backward compatibility, and for how long?
Is BigNumber intentionally excluded from this promotion, or should it be evaluated at the same time given it shares the same rc/components directory?
